controls.label: How it moves
controls.hint: H3 takes a rich prompt — you can describe a timeline, and it generates sound too.

controls.label: Width
controls.hint: Set from the poster when you upload it. Change it if you want a different shape.

controls.label: Height
controls.hint: Set from the poster when you upload it. Change it if you want a different shape.

inputs.label: The poster
inputs.note: The artwork as supplied. It is used as both the first and the last frame, so the clip loops and the typography cannot drift.

params.prompt:
Warm evening light, shallow depth of field, unhurried.

Timeline:
[0s-2s] The sign fills the frame, light catching its edge.
[2s-5s] Slow drift back, the street coming into view behind it.

No cuts, no camera shake, no text overlays.

Audio: Low room tone, distant traffic, no music.

presets.label: Bring it to life
presets.hint: The default. High-energy motion graphics. Add your own detail in the brackets.

values.value:
Animate the source artwork as a motion poster, preserving its exact layout, palette, typography and composition. [describe the artwork here: its border, colours, style, main subject]

It is one continuous, unbroken, locked-off take that holds on this artwork for the entire duration — a single shot, no cuts, staying on the poster from the first frame to the last.

This is a high-energy promotional motion graphic and it should feel like one. Everything that can move, moves, boldly and continuously: the photographed subjects come alive — people breathe and shift, liquid swirls, flames flicker and throw light — while stylised motion-graphics energy plays across the whole frame. Light rays and lens flares sweep through, glows pulse, embers and sparks drift, highlights race along edges, and colour intensifies and blooms. Punchy and a little over the top, with something happening every moment of the clip. Whatever the artwork shows stays itself throughout: a face keeps its own identity and features, a number on any screen or price holds its exact value, and a plate or glass keeps what it holds.

The text and logos hold their designed positions throughout. The camera is locked off and the final frame returns to the original artwork.

presets.label: Type in motion
presets.hint: Lets the type move and glow as well. Riskier — check every word in the result.
